Answer all the questions in this section.

Identify one disadvantage of using anthropology as a source of information in History and

Government. (1 mark)
2. Identify two communities in Kenya which belong to the Wester Bantu group. (2 marks)

the 19" Century. (2 marks)
4. Give one economic duty of a Kenyan citizen, (1 mark)
5. Identify two foreign powers that took control of the Kenyan Coast during the 16" Century.
(2 marks)
6. Which factor influenced Seyyid Said to develop agriculture in Zanzibar during the 16" Century?
(2 marks)

(1 mark)
11. State two features of African farming in Kenya during the colonial period. (2 marks)
